name: FSMO role holders
description: Latest ADConfig_CL role snapshot per selected reporting computer and domain. Requires a Computer column identifying the reporting DC. Separate reporters remain visible to expose inconsistent observations.
kql:
ADConfig_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where isnotempty(DNSRoot)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, DNSRoot
| project Computer, DNSRoot, Timestamp = TimeGenerated, PDCEmulator, RIDMaster, InfrastructureMaster, SchemaMaster, DomainNamingMaster
| order by DNSRoot asc, Computer asc
